# Ophira Resort Residences, Dutamas

> Official project information for Ophira Resort Residences at https://www.ophira-dutamas.com/

Ophira Resort Residences is a freehold, GreenRE-certified serviced apartment development in Dutamas, Kuala Lumpur. It is developed by Chin Hin Property Development.

## Key facts

- Location: Dutamas, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- Tenure: Freehold on commercial-titled land
- Development: Two residential towers with 1,546 homes
- Site area: 4.74 acres
- Home sizes: 525 to 1,020 sq. ft.
- Configurations: 1+1, 2+1, 3 and 4 bedrooms
- Dual-key: Available in selected layouts
- Facilities: 39 facilities across Level 1, Level 10 and the sky garden
- Rail: Nearest KTM commuter rail connection approximately 400 m away
- Target completion: Q4 2031, estimated and subject to approvals and the SPA
- Estimated maintenance: Approximately RM0.36 per sq. ft. per month including sinking fund; actual charges depend on allocated share units

## Layouts

- Type A: 525 sq. ft., 1+1 bedroom
- Type B: 722 sq. ft., 2+1 bedrooms
- Type C: 840 sq. ft., 3 bedrooms
- Type C1: 902 sq. ft., 3 bedrooms, dual-key enabled
- Type D: 1,006 sq. ft., 4 bedrooms
- Type D1: 1,020 sq. ft., 4 bedrooms, dual-key enabled

## Facilities

Highlights include a 50 m lap pool, 4,000 sq. ft. function hall, 3,300 sq. ft. co-working space, 1,350 sq. ft. gymnasium, two pickleball courts, family facilities and a 750 sq. ft. social lounge.
